claims.description: Configured CSS text and document style elements contribute rules in cascade order.

notes.text: Configured stylesheet text and document `style` elements are combined with other supported stylesheet sources in cascade order.

claims.description: Accessible linked stylesheets contribute readable CSS rules.

notes.text: Cross-origin or otherwise inaccessible linked stylesheets cannot contribute rules and route through the unsupported CSS policy.

claims.description: `document.adoptedStyleSheets` participate in their configured cascade order.
Viewport media rules select stylesheet branches from the configured layout viewport.
conditions: Supported media types are `screen` and `all`; other media types do not match.
Width, height, orientation, and aspect-ratio features use the configured viewport.
Query lists, `not`, `only`, `and`, and nested media rules are supported.

notes.text: Wide landscape and narrow portrait fixtures verify matching and non-matching responsive branches against Chromium.

claims.description: Stylesheet at-rules other than supported viewport media rules are not part of the source subset.

notes.text: Unsupported media features and other at-rules route through the configured unsupported CSS policy.
